notes.title: Super Kiwi 64 Free Content Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zJ-KG4ovg8w;full][/previewyoutube]

A free content update for Super Kiwi 64 is out now! It includes:

- A story driven three level bonus story with voice acting called "Doomsday"
- Time Trials for the main game
- Fully voice acted Cutscenes for the main game. 
- Save Files (no more save deleting outside of the game!)
